hypothesis.name: Kneser
evidence: spectrum is integral with 4 distinct eigenvalues (816, 16, -1, -136), as for a vertex-transitive family
lower bound 190 vs upper bound 214 from clique_cover, so a code of length near 190 is needed

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 190 for 1330 receivers. The independent set of size 190 gives the lower bound and a linear code over F_3 with c = 1 (M = I + A) gives the upper bound 190; independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed. One code was tried, with 2 LLM calls and 1 critic round. Wall time was 34.9 s, of which 34.4 s was LLM time and only 0.52 s compute. Against baselines: CP-SAT alpha reached 190 but did not prove it in 123 s, CP-SAT cover and fractional cover gave nothing useful (1152.0 not proven), F2 minrank only bounded 189. The Kushagra agent also closed 190/190 over F_3 in 0.71 s, so it was faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious.
